scope: Review only, exactly ten zh-Hant posters. No rendering, repair, budget action, approval, publication, other-locale edits or original app changes.

verification.images: All ten full-resolution source files opened individually; all are 1206x2622. All ten image hashes and three preview hashes match the manifest; ten hashes are unique and none equals an English output hash.
verification.composition: All nine manifest composition hashes match current files. Every configured frozen source hash matches. Geometry records ten 350px hardware boxes, 48px titles, 56px line heights, two title lines and one focus each; actual pixels confirm readable margins and deliberate lower hardware cropping.
verification.hardware: Local original device PNG and mask hashes match authorized library selection.json.
verification.source_art: Opened nine original source PNGs: eight banquet artworks and the bundled cutout illustration. Their visible art matches the gallery, editing, preview and cutout panels.
verification.fonts: Source CJK mapping and actual rendered glyphs checked: original Noto Serif CJK, handwritten LXGW WenKai TC for 美好相聚 and CJK 花字 previews. Traditional marketing and Simplified chrome render legibly; English Latin text on page 6 is complete. No Cyrillic text is used in this locale, so Cyrillic coverage is not applicable. Exact embedded font bytes were not independently decoded; no native runtime font verification is claimed.
verification.language: AppStore.swift:34-36 resolves zh system languages to the Simplified Chinese branch. Models.swift built-in languages and TemplateLibraryCopy/BanquetPortraitCatalog were inspected. PROVENANCE discloses fallback, user-entered English second-version content and illustrative redraws.
verification.corrections: Page 4 heading and five buttons are separated; page 9 menu is opaque and clear; page 2 selects one run with complete handles; edited Peach font/color/wording persists through saved draft and share.
verification.limitations: No app execution, native acceptance or owner acceptance. Current giant embedded HTML/CSS were hashed without dumping their contents. The frozen English source audit was used with independent locale-specific source and pixel checks.
